cases.purpose: dmsetup queries with no mappings and with a three-segment (linear+zero+error) mapping with a UUID and a zero mapping: ls, info by name, by -u UUID, both, a missing name and a mixed list; info while suspended and with an inactive table; table and status of all devices and one, with --inactive and --target; ls --target; deps of all, one and an inactive table over two loop devices; targets and version. As uid 2000 (control node EACCES) and with /dev/mapper hidden by a tmpfs (control absent): ls, info, table, status, deps and targets. The shell's descriptor count before and after.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; large outputs as a line count and digest. Each side runs in its own IPC namespace, where udev cookie semaphores cannot complete, so mutating commands pass --noudevsync (which the candidate accepts and ignores) and udev is settled before each step; BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1 enables the candidate's mutating commands as root. Mappings sit on per-side loop devices or zero/error targets, are removed by the fixture, and the harness verifies no dm or loop device survives the side.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
RT=/tmp/rt; /usr/bin/mkdir -p $RT
seed() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; n=int(sys.argv[2]); open(sys.argv[1],"wb").write(bytes((i*7+i//251)%256 for i in range(n)))' "$1" "$2"; }
sz() { /usr/sbin/blockdev --getsize64 "$1"; }
sha() { /usr/bin/sha256sum < "$1" | /usr/bin/cut -c1-16; }
# udev probes each new loop device; settle before detaching so the detach is
# immediate, and wait for sysfs to drop the association before the next attach.
settle() { /usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 >/dev/null 2>&1; }
gone() { local x=${1#/dev/} i; for ((i=0;i<50;i++)); do [[ -e /sys/block/$x/loop/backing_file ]] || return 0; /usr/bin/sleep 0.1; done; echo "  $x still attached"; }
att() { /usr/sbin/losetup "$@"; settle; }
detach() { local d; for d; do /usr/sbin/losetup -d $d; gone $d; done; }
export BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1
D() { settle; /usr/sbin/dmsetup --noudevsync "$@"; }
r() { settle; local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { settle; local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
rt() { D table "$1" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed 's/^/  table: /'; }
inf() { D info "$1" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/^\(State\|Tables present\|UUID\|Number of targets\|Open count\): */  \1: /p'; }
ex() { if D info "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "  $1 exists"; else echo "  $1 absent"; fi; }
minor() { D info -c --noheadings -o minor "$1"; }
# rs LABEL CMD: like r, but stdout is summarized as a line count and digest.
rs() { settle; local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; local s=$?
  printf '%s status=%s lines=%s sha=%s err=' "$l" $s "$(/usr/bin/wc -l < /tmp/rf.out)" "$(sha /tmp/rf.out)"; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
fds() { local a=(/proc/$BASHPID/fd/*); n=${#a[@]}; }
cd $RT; seed a.img 65536; seed b.img 65536; d1=$(att -f --show a.img); d2=$(att -f --show b.img)
fds; before=$n
r ls-empty dmsetup ls
r info-empty dmsetup info
r table-empty dmsetup table
printf '0 16 linear %s 0\n16 16 zero\n32 16 error\n' $d1 | D create -u RF-UUID-A rf-a || echo SETUP-FAILED
D create rf-b --table '0 64 zero' || echo SETUP-FAILED
r ls dmsetup ls
r info dmsetup info
r info-a dmsetup info rf-a
r info-uuid dmsetup info -u RF-UUID-A
r info-uuid-and-name dmsetup info -u RF-UUID-A rf-a
r info-missing dmsetup info rf-none
r info-mixed dmsetup info rf-a rf-none rf-b
D suspend rf-b; r info-suspended dmsetup info rf-b; D resume rf-b
D load rf-b --table '0 64 error'; r info-inactive dmsetup info rf-b
r table dmsetup table
r table-a dmsetup table rf-a
r status dmsetup status
r status-a dmsetup status rf-a
r table-inactive dmsetup table --inactive rf-b
r status-inactive dmsetup status --inactive rf-b
r table-target dmsetup table --target zero
r status-target dmsetup status --target error
r ls-target dmsetup ls --target error
r deps dmsetup deps
r deps-a dmsetup deps rf-a
printf '0 16 linear %s 0\n16 16 linear %s 0\n' $d1 $d2 | D load rf-a
r deps-inactive dmsetup deps --inactive rf-a
D clear rf-a; D clear rf-b
r targets dmsetup targets
r version dmsetup version
for v in ls info table status deps targets; do u "eacces-$v" "dmsetup $v"; done
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=64k rf-nomapper /dev/mapper || echo SETUP-FAILED
for v in ls info table status deps targets; do r "absent-$v" dmsetup $v; done
/usr/bin/umount /dev/mapper
D remove_all
fds; [[ $n == "$before" ]] && echo "  shell descriptors unchanged" || echo "  shell descriptors $before -> $n"
detach $d1 $d2; echo teardown=ok

cases.purpose: dmsetup state changes with every suspend, remove, clear, rename and message request recorded (flags and name): suspend/resume plain, --noflush and --nolockfs; clear of an inactive table; wipe_table; remove of a device held open, remove --force while open, remove --deferred then the last close; a multi-name remove and suspend with a missing name in the middle; remove_all; rename, rename --setuuid twice, to an existing name, to a 130-character name and to a name with a slash; message @stats_create, @stats_list (core device-mapper statistics, deterministic replies), at a nonzero sector, and an unsupported message.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout, stderr and the recorded requests: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; LVM2 readback (State, Tables present, UUID, table, existence) after each step. DM ioctls are recorded by helpers/system-sequence.py notifications that let the kernel run each request; the flags shown are the request's dm_ioctl flags masked to the documented request bits (0x2ffff), leaving out libdevmapper's udev cookie bits. Each side runs in its own IPC namespace, where udev cookie semaphores cannot complete, so mutating commands pass --noudevsync (which the candidate accepts and ignores) and udev is settled before each step; BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1 enables the candidate's mutating commands as root. Mappings sit on per-side loop devices or zero/error targets, are removed by the fixture, and the harness verifies no dm or loop device survives the side.

cases.purpose: dmsetup create of a linear mapping over a loop device: the /dev/mapper node after udev settles, bytes written through the mapping read back from the loop device; the node after remove and settling; remove --retry while another process holds the mapping open for two seconds; info -c, -C with -o/--noheadings/--separator/--sort and --select; create with -U/-G/-M and the resulting node owner, group and mode.
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr: one line per invocation with its status, stdout and the diagnostic minus any "NAME: line N: " shell-location prefix; node presence, the read-back bytes, node ownership. Each side runs in its own IPC namespace, where udev cookie semaphores cannot complete, so mutating commands pass --noudevsync (which the candidate accepts and ignores) and udev is settled before each step; BASHOS_DMSETUP_ALLOW_MUTATE=1 enables the candidate's mutating commands as root. Mappings sit on per-side loop devices or zero/error targets, are removed by the fixture, and the harness verifies no dm or loop device survives the side. Udev cookie synchronization itself (--udevcookie, --verifyudev) is not observable here: it needs the cookie semaphore in the namespace udevd uses.
